literal_actual_ask_overlaps.question: A Spirit chooses Growth with two Add Presence actions. May the second placement use the first as its range origin? Which Presence-track disks may be taken, and how do uncovered Energy/Card Plays numbers combine?
A Growth option includes an impossible instruction and an explicit cost. Can it be selected, can possible instructions be skipped, and may one Spirit wait for another’s Growth result before choosing?
Must a land at Range 0 contain your Presence? Can a numeric Range boost waive a Sacred Site origin, a target-terrain restriction or the text “one of your lands”?
If Gather 3 or Push 3 lacks “up to,” may the player move only one when three legal pieces are available? What if only two are available? Can unrestricted Move leave a piece in its current land?

A Spirit has several separate Growth options and no instruction allowing more than one choice. During one Spirit Phase, may it combine the Energy action from one option with the Add Presence action from a different option, or must it choose a single entire option?

An ordinary land-targeting Power has printed Range 1, Target ANY and no special origin requirement. Your Presence is in land A, and land B is adjacent to A. Assuming all other restrictions are met, may you target A as well as B, or must the target be exactly one land away from your Presence?

A Spirit with no Energy remaining receives Gift of Strength and has already used an eligible cost-1 Power Card. May it use that card's Repeat without paying its cost again, or does Gift require the same repayment as Powerstorm?

When Green adds Presence via Growth, may it use destroyed disks while tracks still contain Presence? What is the price while Healthy versus Blighted? Does this special rule also let an ordinary Power Add Presence use destroyed disks?

Ocean chooses its Growth option with two “Add a Presence in any Ocean” instructions. May one disk be placed in the Ocean of a different island board where Ocean currently has no Presence, without measuring a numeric Range from its existing Presence?
Green chooses its Reclaim-and-gain-Power Growth group. Does it also perform the separate ALWAYS Add Presence to Jungle/Wetland, or must it choose between that addition and Reclaim?

literal_actual_ask_overlaps.question: Explain how Elements apply to multiple thresholds and multiple Powers. May an innate be used twice with twice the Elements, may its levels use different lands, and how does an “Instead” level work?
What cards does ordinary Reclaim return, and when and how often can a newly uncovered Reclaim One space be used?
A Power’s earlier instruction uncovers an Element needed for a later threshold. Can that later threshold apply? What if Elements are lost instead, and can earlier resolved effects be revised?

A Power has a lower threshold requiring 2 Water and a higher threshold requiring 3 Water. Its Spirit has 3 Water. May the Spirit resolve that Power as if it had only 2 Water, getting the lower threshold but not the higher one? May another Power still check the Spirit's actual 3 Water later this turn? Assume no instruction gains or loses Elements.

literal_actual_ask_overlaps.question: A Power was used Fast, then is explicitly made Slow before its ordinary Repeat. Which phase does the Repeat use? What if its text explicitly tells you to Repeat immediately?
